newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds barely changed and quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds barely changed and quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were barely changed on Monday with little interest reported.
"We have not seen anything that looks remotely like a trade," said one broker.
Nearby high protein soymeal was around one stg up while forward positions were unchanged.
Old crop rapemeal from the Liverpool and Hull mills was one stg down while new crop was unchanged.
Rapemeal and sunflower pellets from the Erith mill were unchanged.
Ex-store sunflower meal and corn gluten feed pellets were also unchanged.
